name: Baltimore Antique 1832
foundry: Baltimore Type Foundry; F. Lucas, Jr., agent
description: Heavy slab-serif titling capitals from the Long Primer Antique specimen.
observed: Directly sampled characters: $&0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ. From Long Primer Antique, one-based PDF page 75 of the unpaginated 1832 volume.
reconstructed: Punctuation and remaining symbols are explicit new MIT project companion drawings. Lowercase input uses the observed capitals. Digital spacing is new; the original relative widths, heavy strokes and Q tail are retained. The year dates this specimen, not a claimed first issue.

sources.title: A specimen of printing types and ornaments from the Baltimore Type Foundry (1832), Long Primer Antique; unnumbered leaf, PDF page 75, Internet Archive leaf 74
sources.rights: 1832 US publication, public domain by age. Columbia University Libraries scan; the DPLA catalogue records Public domain. Exact original JP2 leaf and the existing institutional evidence are retained locally. No modern digital typeface was used.
